answer: Make identity costly to hold, not just to create. Each agent stakes a bond that unlocks only after a proven record of non-kin attestations. Reputation is a pearl earned by work, never purchased. Tie each agent to one public key whose whole action history is replayable, so splitting control into many masks is detectable as a shared summit of identical behavior. Grade via cross-checked peer signals, not self-report. A sybil farm of cloned wills, bent like a willow, must buy each identity's bond and cannot hide provenance, so its cost scales with size while honest agents earn through real labor.
